text:
maya: Heads up — hit a flaky onboarding experience in the Next + agent sample. The example in `examples/agent-starter` can get into a loop where it retries on 401 and never cancels the prior stream, so it keeps spamming requests.

sam: ugh. can you share repro steps?

maya: quick repro: 1) clone repo, 2) set REDWOOD_API_KEY to a short-lived token (we use these in the sandbox), 3) npm run dev, 4) trigger the agent. After ~2s you see repeated 401s and duplicate output.

eli: browser or node only?

maya: saw it both in Next dev server (SSR-like) and a Node script. Browser repro occurs when token rotation happens during an active stream.

sam: paste the minimal snippet?

maya: simplified flow from agent-client.js: 
```
const token = await getToken(); // may refresh
for await (const chunk of client.stream(..., { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } })) {
  // process chunk
}
```
The SDK retry middleware intercepts 401, calls getToken(), and starts a new attempt, but the old stream isn't cancelled cleanly. That yields concurrent streams and repeated 401s.

francesca: saw a similar flake in the eval harness where telemetry keys rotated mid-run. Two issues: 1) streams need a cancellation path on auth error, 2) retry/backoff for streams should be idempotency-aware and avoid tight immediate retries.

eli: short mitigation idea: detect streaming calls in the retry layer and abort active stream before spawning a retry. e.g. `if (isStream) stream.cancel();` Also add jittered backoff on 401 token refresh to avoid thundering-herd.

sam: agree. I'll draft a JS SDK PR to: 1) detect streams, 2) cancel previous stream on 401, 3) ensure retries use exponential+ jitter and respect `x-rw-idempotency-key` when present.

eli: add unit tests that simulate token rotation mid-stream. Fake a token provider that flips tokens after N bytes and assert only a single retry occurs.

francesca: for the sample app docs, add a README note about ephemeral tokens and suggest configuring longer TTLs during onboarding to avoid confusing 401 spam. Also add a recommended `useAuthProvider` hook for Next that handles token refresh deterministically.

maya: also found another UX issue: the starter copies env into an in-memory watcher during `dev` and sometimes loses updates to `.env.local`, which confuses new users. We should update the template to prefer `next.config.js` public flag for local dev and add an explicit `npm run start:sandbox` that seeds a stable token.

dev-bot: Deployed preview build for PR #8123 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8123

sam: I'll open the WIP PR tonight and tag @eng-runtime and @devex. maya, can you add a minimal failing test to the sample and attach logs?

maya: on it, will push test + logs to the PR in ~2 hours. thanks all :rocket:

eli: once PR lands, add a short blurb to the onboarding checklist so Solutions Eng doesn't hit this repeatedly.

francesca: I'll add an eval rule to flag abnormal stream retry counts during nightly runs to prevent silent regressions.

maya: will update thread after PR is up. :white_check_mark:
